# István Zoltán Szász — Full-Stack Developer

> István Zoltán Szász (also written Istvan Zoltan Szasz) is a Full-Stack Web Developer and Computer Science Engineer based in Érd, Hungary. He has 5+ years of experience building high-performance web applications with a strong specialisation in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and the modern JavaScript ecosystem. He holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science Engineering from Óbuda University (Alba Regia Faculty of Engineering), Székesfehérvár, Hungary, graduated February 2025.

## Professional Summary

István is a Full-Stack Developer with over 5 years of hands-on experience. He specialises in building modern, responsive, and performance-optimised web applications. His frontend expertise centres around React and Next.js, while his backend work covers Node.js, Express.js, REST API design, and database management (SQL & NoSQL). He is also experienced in mobile development with React Native and 3D development using Unreal Engine 5.
